contract: Persist creative direction projects with reviewed treatment text, exact canonical Work or ordered Series revisions, and dependency-ordered production steps. Source pins reuse the canonical creative.13 chapter/work/draft/artifact/version/content-hash tuple without copying manuscripts. Deterministic source verification and readonly treatment snapshot steps execute one at a time through optimistic revision control. Pause, restart, edit remaining work and resume while completed step definitions, results and attempt history remain immutable.
acceptance: Create and reopen an idempotent direction project whose Work or ordered Series source resolves to real immutable manuscript artifacts and exact content hashes; missing or unprepared sources create no placeholder project.
Start and complete a real source verification step, pause, reopen the store, replace the remaining plan, resume and finish while the completed step and result remain unchanged.
Treatment snapshot execution creates and reopens an actual readonly canonical markdown artifact with verified content hash and artifact route; source drift blocks execution without false completion.
Owner HTTP, console and approval-gated native tools exercise real persistence and lifecycle controls; stale revisions and invalid state transitions fail explicitly.

limitations: Shared creative route registration, page mounting and direction SQLite durability enrollment remain root integration hooks.
